rulesTestNames: lets managers read live guest and settings views and nothing else
owner: Live guest and settings view evaluator: hostReadModels guest view triggers
read: current organizer managers get their own organizer's views by id; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; one per configured group (event:whole included) and console workflow kind (late join) of an event with an eventFormat and an endTime, deleted with the group or the event
migrationNotes: A group's view inherits the event:whole setting of the same kind; a change to that setting re-evaluates the event's views.
The view reads no clock; serverTime is the phone's read instant.
